name: Atom Cats garage
real_counterpart: Squantum, at the head of the Moon Island causeway (Dorchester St and Moon Island Rd)
note: Squantum, at the head of the causeway to Moon Island: the greasers sit on the only road to their neighbours, the Warwicks.

name: Boston Airport
note: Brotherhood of Steel and the Prydwen. Its workshop opens only to the Brotherhood, so it is not a Minutemen settlement.

name: Cambridge crater
real_counterpart: City block at Binney St, First St, Rogers St and Edwin H. Land Blvd, East Cambridge
note: A city block that took a direct hit in the Great War. Placed by its real neighbours on the game map (Kendall, the Longfellow Bridge and the Museum of Science) on the block bounded by Binney, First and Rogers Streets and Land Boulevard. About 400 ft across, it fits a surface burst of around 55 kilotons. With the Charles a couple of hundred feet away, the bowl floods from below, which would explain the hot water in it.

name: Cambridge Police Station
note: Brotherhood of Steel forward base: Paladin Danse's recon squad holds it, and vertibirds fly from it to the Prydwen.

name: Crater of Atom
note: Ground zero of the Glowing Sea. On real ground it falls in the western corner of Walpole, a few hundred yards from the Norfolk and Medfield lines. Its crater, about 1,000 ft across, fits a surface burst of roughly a megaton.

name: Fort Strong
note: Ruined coastal batteries on Long Island Head. Reachable only by water in our world since its bridge closed in 2014.

name: Four Leaf fishpacking plant
real_counterpart: Boston Fish Pier, South Boston waterfront
note: Boston Fish Pier, the working fish-processing pier on the South Boston waterfront.

name: General Atomics Factory
real_counterpart: Boston Army Base, now the Boston Design Center, Drydock Ave
note: The old Boston Army Base on Drydock Avenue, a block of concrete warehouses that is now the Boston Design Center.

name: Hangman's Alley
real_counterpart: Back Street, Back Bay, between Charlesgate East and Massachusetts Ave
note: Back Street, the service alley behind the river side of Beacon Street, at the foot of the Harvard Bridge. Walled in by row houses on one side and Storrow Drive on the other.

name: Home Plate
note: Has a workshop, but it is the player's own house in Diamond City: no settlers, so not a Minutemen settlement.

name: Kingsport Lighthouse
real_counterpart: Derby Wharf Light, at the end of Derby Wharf in Salem Harbor
note: Derby Wharf Light, the small lighthouse at the end of Derby Wharf, reaching out into Salem Harbor. Marblehead Light, on the Neck of Lovecraft's model for Kingsport, is the other candidate, but it lies about 2 miles outside the game map's edge.

name: Mahkra Fishpacking
real_counterpart: Northey Point, a point jutting into the North River, North Salem
note: Northey Point, a small point jutting into the North River in North Salem, southeast of the Nakano house across the water.

name: Nahant Oceanological Society
real_counterpart: Northeastern Marine Science Center, East Point

name: Nakano residence
real_counterpart: Kernwood waterfront, North Salem, on the Danvers River beside the Kernwood Marina
note: On the Danvers River waterfront at Kernwood, North Salem, beside the Kernwood Marina: a house with a dock and a boat, as the Nakanos' was. The game puts it right at the top of the map, and the map's edge is drawn to take it in.

name: The Prydwen
note: Brotherhood of Steel airship, moored over the airport.

name: Warwick homestead
real_counterpart: Moon Island sewage works: the 1884 granite storage tanks of Boston's Main Drainage, Quincy Bay
note: Moon Island, Quincy Bay. The game's farm was a sewage plant with two great tanks; Moon Island held Boston's sewage in four granite tanks, 900 ft long, from 1884 until 1968, reached by a causeway from Squantum.

name: Wreck of the FMS Northern Star
real_counterpart: Aground on the ledge at Hangman Island, Quincy Bay
note: Aground on the ledge at Hangman Island in Quincy Bay, southeast of Moon Island.

name: Yangtze
real_counterpart: Main ship channel off the Fish Pier, between the Seaport and Logan
note: Captain Zao's submarine, lying in the main ship channel off the Fish Pier, between the Seaport and Logan.
